display.title: Achdus: The Secret Word Is Unity
display.summary_short: From the very first broadcast: Uncle Yossi teaches that the secret word is achdus, bringing people together in peace, kindness and brotherly love.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the premiere of Tzivos Hashem on the Air. Uncle Yossi tells children that the secret word of the program is achdus, unity and togetherness. We live at a time when unity is badly needed, so we must do all we can to help one another, be kind to our fellow man and bring about peace and harmony; in return we will find a better world to live in. He then invites every listener to take a first step toward unity right now by doing something together, as a start to many more good deeds. The clip ends just before the activity itself, which is the Shema said together in the full episode.
display.lesson: Achdus: help one another, be kind and bring people together in peace, and the world becomes a better place.
